proposals.issue_title: Fragile Image API Pipeline & Silent Failures
proposals.current_pain_description: Currently, if HuggingFace, Gemini, or Horde fail, the pipelines crash or produce raw Pollinations images of unacceptable commercial quality. There is no unified error handling or automatic fallback sequence across different image endpoints.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a centralized `image_factory.py` module. Implement a strict fallback cascade with retry backoffs: 1) Together AI (FLUX-schnell, free tier), 2) Cloudflare Workers AI (10k free neurons), 3) Runware (PAYG, cost-capped), 4) Pollinations (as absolute fallback with enhanced prompt engineering to boost quality). Track API cost per run dynamically.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Prevents pipeline crashes, optimizes the 20 euro budget, and guarantees high-quality FLUX outputs without manual intervention.

proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo only has an Android phone (Termux). Downloading large ZIP artifacts from GitHub Actions runs to inspect generated book covers or coloring pages is slow, data-heavy, and painful on a mobile browser.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate a lightweight Telegram or Discord Webhook notifier at the end of every production GHA run. The workflow will post compressed, low-res JPG previews of the generated assets directly to a private channel/chat along with a link to trigger the 'approve/publish' GHA workflow via repository dispatch.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves Hugo hours of tedious manual file management on Termux, allowing instant 'go/no-go' decisions directly from his phone's notification tray.

proposals.issue_title: Lack of Automated Mockup Generation for Etsy/Redbubble
proposals.current_pain_description: Even if high-quality SVGs or PNGs are generated, they cannot be listed on Etsy or Redbubble without mockups. Creating mockups manually on an Android phone is nearly impossible, blocking the 'amorçage' phase from generating actual revenue.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a Python-based mockup generator step using `Pillow`. Pre-stage 3-5 flat, open-source mockup templates (blank book, mug, t-shirt, frame) in the GitHub repository. The script will automatically overlay, warp, or mask the generated designs onto these templates and save them as ready-to-upload gallery images.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Enables immediate, fully-automated listing creation on POD platforms straight from GHA outputs.

proposals.issue_title: Runware Budget Exhaustion Risk (Infinite Loop Prevention)
proposals.current_pain_description: Runware is a paid PAYG service. A malfunctioning GHA loop, an unhandled exception retrying endlessly, or an accidental concurrent run could drain Hugo's 20€ monthly budget in minutes, locking him out of production.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a local file-based budget tracker (`.budget_state.json`) stored and updated via a fast Git commit/push step at the end of each image generation loop, or query Runware's account balance API before every batch. If the daily spent exceeds 1€ or monthly exceeds 18€, automatically force-fail the workflow with a clear warning.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates the risk of unexpected API bills, keeping the solo business financially safe.

proposals.issue_title: Zero Cross-Pollination of Single Assets into Multiple Formats
proposals.current_pain_description: Assets are generated in silos (e.g., a coloring book is generated only as a book PDF for KDP). The individual high-quality pages are not recycled, wasting potential traffic and revenue on other platforms.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a `cross_pollination_orchestrator.py` script. When a coloring book is generated: 1) Extract individual pages, package them as digital download ZIPs for Etsy, 2) Convert selected pages into SVGs for Cults3D (as 2D laser-cutting vectors), 3) Generate a short mp4 slideshow/flipbook using `ffmpeg` on GHA for Pinterest/TikTok marketing.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Multiplies the return on investment (ROI) per hour worked by turning 1 generated asset into 3 distinct platform listings automatically.

proposals.issue_title: Coloring Book Line Art Quality Issues (Gray Shading & Artifacts)
proposals.current_pain_description: Raw image models (like FLUX-schnell or Pollinations) often generate 'coloring pages' with gray gradients, shading, sketchy lines, or dark backgrounds. These get rejected by KDP customers and look highly unprofessional.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate an automated image post-processing step using `opencv-python` and `Pillow` in GHA. Apply adaptive thresholding (e.g., Otsu's binarization) to convert images into pure high-contrast black and white lines, dilate lines slightly to clean up noise, and output crisp transparent-background PNGs.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Guarantees publishable, commercial-grade line art quality, completely removing sketchy artifacts.
